public_rationale: A planned consumer release was canceled amid reported cost cutting. The broader AR-glasses program continued, with substantial development and later models still planned before the post. Thus the narrower cancellation has support, while the apparent claim that Meta canceled its AR-glasses plans is contradicted. The AI funding destination was expressly an assumption and remains unverified.
limitations: The result depends on the scope of 'them'.
The cancellation and roadmap evidence comes from reporting rather than a published internal decision record.
Cost-cutting context does not establish the precise causal motive or amount saved.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Meta canceled its AR glasses plans to save money, which the author assumes is now being spent on AI.
